impl_requirements: Provide a @triton.jit kernel plus a plain Python launcher that computes the grid and calls kernel[grid](...). No PYBIND11; the launcher returns the output tensor directly.
read_metric_guide: High dram_pct with low sm_pct => memory_bound. High sm_pct with low dram_pct => compute_bound. Low occupancy with neither saturated => latency_occupancy. Many short kernels / launch-dominated wall time => overhead_bound.

vectorized_load_store.idiom: block-shaped tl.load / tl.store over contiguous offsets
vectorized_load_store.prompt_guidance: Load and store whole BLOCK-sized tiles with tl.arange offsets so Triton vectorizes the access into wide transactions.

memory_coalescing.idiom: contiguous tl.load via block pointers / tl.make_block_ptr
memory_coalescing.prompt_guidance: Lay out program_id-to-offset so the last (contiguous) axis varies fastest; use tl.make_block_ptr for clean coalesced tiles.

shared_memory_tiling.idiom: BLOCK_M/BLOCK_N/BLOCK_K tl.load tiles staged through shared memory by the compiler
shared_memory_tiling.prompt_guidance: Pick BLOCK_M/BLOCK_N/BLOCK_K so each program reuses an operand tile across the K loop; tile-shape choice is the lever that lets Triton stage data through shared memory for you.

async_copy_pipeline.idiom: num_stages software pipelining of the K loop
async_copy_pipeline.prompt_guidance: Raise num_stages (and tune num_warps) so Triton emits cp.async-backed multi-stage prefetch of the next K tile.

l2_cache_reuse.prompt_guidance: Reorder program_id launch order (group along M) so co-scheduled programs reuse the same B columns from L2.

tensor_core_mma.prompt_guidance: Express the inner GEMM as tl.dot(a, b) on fp16/bf16 tiles so Triton lowers it to tensor-core mma.

instruction_reduction.prompt_guidance: Mark shapes/strides tl.constexpr so the compiler folds bounds math and unrolls the inner loop.

fast_math_intrinsics.prompt_guidance: Use tl.math.exp2 and fast libdevice paths for transcendentals (exp/log/sin/rsqrt) instead of exact ops. Where accuracy allows, additionally set allow_tf32=True and accumulate in fp16/bf16 to cut multiply cost.

register_tiling.idiom: larger BLOCK_M x BLOCK_N register accumulator
register_tiling.prompt_guidance: Grow the accumulator tile shape so each program holds more of the output in registers, raising arithmetic intensity.

occupancy_increase.idiom: tune num_warps to raise resident warps
occupancy_increase.prompt_guidance: Adjust num_warps (and shrink the block) so more warps stay resident per SM.

block_size_tuning.prompt_guidance: Sweep BLOCK_M/BLOCK_N/BLOCK_K and num_warps with @triton.autotune to find the best geometry for the SM.

register_pressure_reduction.idiom: smaller BLOCK tile / fewer live tl values
register_pressure_reduction.prompt_guidance: Shrink the tile shape and reuse buffers so the kernel needs fewer live registers and avoids spills.

launch_config_tuning.idiom: grid lambda and num_warps/num_stages in the launcher
launch_config_tuning.prompt_guidance: Tune the grid lambda plus num_warps/num_stages passed at kernel[grid](...) launch to match the problem shape.

kernel_fusion.idiom: fuse the elementwise epilogue inside the @triton.jit kernel
kernel_fusion.prompt_guidance: Apply the activation / bias / scaling on the accumulator before tl.store so no second kernel is launched.

launch_overhead_reduction.prompt_guidance: Coarsen the grid so each program does more work, cutting the number of launches and their overhead.

library_fallback_hybrid.idiom: fall back to torch.matmul / cuBLAS for the hot op
library_fallback_hybrid.prompt_guidance: If a vendor GEMM beats the Triton kernel, delegate the heavy op to torch.matmul and keep Triton for fusable glue.

cpu_gpu_overlap.idiom: non_blocking H2D copies on a side CUDA stream
cpu_gpu_overlap.prompt_guidance: Issue host->device transfers with non_blocking=True on a separate stream so they overlap kernel launches.
